context:
Goal: degen is finished and handed to you, as you asked.
Problem (goal): you said on item 827 c (15:03 CST Nov 14): "ideally u finish up on degen fast and hand it off to me (but get it fully done)". It does not say what "hand it off" covers. Degen holds 16 open draft PRs that none of the build's merge sessions was handed, so "fully done" is not true yet. Only you can say what handed off means.
Based on (ruling): own-827-c-owner-merged-degen (your word, filed 15:05 CST), and own-degen-home-switch-now (runner 11 merges degen per lane; your 827 c answer does not withdraw it).
Based on (read, runner 11's REST read at 15:07 CST, unchecked by triage, which has no read access to degen): 16 open PRs, all drafts: #722, #721, #715, #711, #694, #683, #675, #671, #660, #653, #646, #542, #539, #538, #534, #386; none handed to runner 11; nothing of its is mid-merge; degen main push runs it read are green (974).
Departs from: main — runner 11 merges every handed-in, reviewed degen lane and the other 16 drafts belong to other sessions; option a hands degen to you now and leaves the drafts with their own sessions, option b has runner 11 drive the drafts to merge or close first, option c has you name the drafts that count.
Meanwhile: runner 11 touches no draft until you answer (the coordinator told it), and nothing else waits on this item.
Option a is starred at the coordinator's recommendation (15:11 CST Nov 14); it does not widen any guard. How long the 16 drafts take is unmeasured.
home: rulings own-827-c-owner-merged-degen and own-degen-home-switch-now; batch runner 11

short: Do the 16 open degen drafts count as part of done before the hand-off?
title: You said to finish degen fast, fully done, and hand it off to you. Does that include the 16 open drafts (other sessions' lanes)? Hand over now (a), runner 11 drives the drafts to merge or close first (b), or you name which drafts count (c)?
why: Your 827 c note names a hand-off but not what it covers. Degen has 16 open draft PRs and none was handed to the merge session, so a wrong guess either leaves work unfinished or has two sessions merging.
